messages.content: Create a 1,600 m main set for advanced 100 freestyle swimmers in a 25 m pool. Objective: race-pace repeatability. No paddles. Six swimmers per lane.

# Race-Pace Preparation
8x50 Free @ 1:10 RPE 6 - 25 smooth / 25 build, verify breakout line
# Main Set
2 rounds:
6x25 Free @ 0:40 RPE 8 - goal second-50 tempo, stop the rep if mechanics fail
2x100 Free @ 2:30 RPE 8 - broken 25 at each wall, total the swimming time
1x200 Choice @ 4:00 RPE 2 - reset
Coach check: confirm lane order, actual completion time and stroke integrity before reducing recovery. Total main work: 1,600 m.
Modify 8x100 butterfly with paddles for an athlete with a coach-entered shoulder restriction. Preserve aerobic purpose.

# Adapted Aerobic Main Set
4x100 Free or Back @ 1:45 RPE 5 - no paddles, relaxed shoulder loading
8x50 choice drill/swim @ 1:05 RPE 5 - use only coach-cleared pain-free stroke choices
4x100 Free @ 1:45 RPE 6 - stable aerobic effort
Coach check: This is a programming draft, not medical clearance. Confirm the athlete's approved restrictions and stop/modify according to the qualified professional's plan.
